extracted.intended_audience: USPTO examiners, patent attorneys/agents, patent applicants, and other practitioners involved in US patent prosecution
extracted.subtask_description: Table of contents page for the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) Eighth Edition Rev. 2, listing chapter and appendix headings that correspond to procedural and substantive standards used in US patent examination and prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: 100 Secrecy, Access, National Security, and Foreign Filing
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter concerning secrecy orders, access restrictions, national security considerations, and foreign filing requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page lists the chapter heading only; consult MPEP chapter 100 for full statutory/regulatory standards and procedural guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 200 Types, Cross-Noting, and Status of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter addressing various types of patent applications, cross-noting, and status issues for applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP chapter 200 for detailed criteria and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: 300 Ownership and Assignment
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter covering requirements and rules on ownership, assignment, and related recordation matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP chapter 300 for substantive and procedural guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 400 Representative of Inventor or Owner
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter regarding representation before the USPTO (attorneys/agents), power of attorney, and practitioner conduct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult MPEP chapter 400 for full standards on representation and practitioner requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: 500 Receipt and Handling of Mail and Papers
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter about receipt, handling, and filing of correspondence, papers, and related timing issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to MPEP chapter 500 for procedural rules and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: 600 Parts, Form, and Content of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on required parts of a patent application and formal/form content requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP chapter 600 for detailed filing requirements, form standards, and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: 700 Examination of Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter addressing substantive examination procedures, examiner actions, and evaluation criteria during prosecution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult MPEP chapter 700 for the standards and step-by-step examination guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 800 Restriction in Applications Filed Under 35 U.S.C. 111; Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on restriction practice and double patenting issues under 35 U.S.C. 111.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP chapter 800 for policies, examples, and examiner/applicant guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 900 Prior Art, Classification, Search
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter concerning prior art, classification systems, and search practices used by examiners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to MPEP chapter 900 for search standards and prior art handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1000 Matters Decided by Various U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Officials
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter describing which matters are decided by different USPTO officials and related procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP chapter 1000 for procedural delineations and decision-making standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1100 Statutory Invention Registration (SIR) and Pre-Grant Publication (PG Pub)
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on statutory invention registration and rules for pre-grant publication of applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult MPEP chapter 1100 for statutory criteria and procedural guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1200 Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter covering appeal procedures from examiner decisions to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board and related practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP chapter 1200 for filing, briefing, and procedural standards for appeals.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1300 Allowance and Issue
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter regarding allowance, issuance of patents, and post-allowance formalities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to MPEP chapter 1300 for requirements and procedures for allowance and patent issue.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1400 Correction of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on correction mechanisms for issued patents (e.g., certificate of correction, reissue).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP chapter 1400 for criteria and procedures to correct patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1500 Design Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter covering prosecution and examination standards specific to design patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult MPEP chapter 1500 for form/content and substantive requirements for design patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1600 Plant Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter addressing plant patent practice and examination standards for plant-related inventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to MPEP chapter 1600 for plant patent requirements and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1700 Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter for miscellaneous topics not covered elsewhere in the manual.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See chapter 1700 in the MPEP for specific miscellaneous policies and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1800 Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on PCT practice and international filing procedures under the Patent Cooperation Treaty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult MPEP chapter 1800 for PCT filing standards and procedural guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1900 Protest
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter concerning protest practice and the handling of third-party protests against patent applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP chapter 1900 for criteria and procedures for protests.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2000 Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on the duty of disclosure (duty to disclose material information to the USPTO) and related ethics/practice issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to MPEP chapter 2000 for standards, examples, and practitioner obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2100 Patentability
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter covering the substantive patentability requirements (novelty, non-obviousness, statutory subject matter, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP chapter 2100 for detailed statutory and case-law-based patentability criteria used in examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2200 Citation of Prior Art and Ex Parte Reexamination of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on citation of prior art, third-party submissions, and ex parte reexamination procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult MPEP chapter 2200 for standards on prior art citation and reexamination practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2300 Interference Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter addressing interference proceedings (priority disputes) and related procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to MPEP chapter 2300 for interference standards and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2400 Biotechnology
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on biotechnology-specific examination issues and standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See chapter 2400 in the MPEP for biotech-related guidance and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2500 Maintenance Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter covering payment and maintenance of fees required to keep patents in force.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult MPEP chapter 2500 for fee schedules, timing, and procedural requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2600 Optional Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter describing optional inter partes reexamination procedures and standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP chapter 2600 for inter partes reexamination criteria and process.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2700 Patent Terms and Extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter regarding calculation of patent terms, term adjustments, and extensions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to MPEP chapter 2700 for rules on term adjustments and extension calculations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix I - Partial List of Trademarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix providing a partial list of trademarks (listed in the MPEP appendix section).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page lists the appendix heading only; consult Appendix I in the MPEP for the full list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix II - List of Decisions Cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix listing decisions cited throughout the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Appendix II in the MPEP for full citations and references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix L - Patent Laws
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix containing the consolidated patent laws referenced by the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult Appendix L for statutory text and related notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix R - Patent Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix containing the consolidated patent rules referenced by the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Appendix R for the current rules and regulatory text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix T - Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix with PCT materials and instructions referenced by the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to Appendix T for PCT-specific provisions and administrative instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix AI - Administrative Instructions Under The PCT
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix covering administrative instructions under the PCT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult Appendix AI for the administrative guidance applicable to PCT practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix P - Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix containing materials related to the Paris Convention referenced by the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Appendix P for Paris Convention provisions relevant to filings and priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index - Subject Matter Index
rubrics_metrics.description: Subject matter index for the MPEP to locate topics and chapter references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the MPEP subject matter index to find specific provisions or topics within the manual.
